Class xyz.File ¶

Utility class to manipulate files.

Seek constants ¶

These constants can be used with seek().

xyz.File.SEEK_SET¶

Seek from the beginning of the file.
xyz.File.SEEK_CUR¶

Seek from the current position.
xyz.File.SEEK_END¶

Seek to the end of the file.

Class API ¶

Synopsis

Methods
xyz.File()

Opens a new file
seek()

Seeks within the file
xyz.File(name, mode) ¶

Opens a new file.

Example
f = xyz.File('/etc/passwd')
f.seek(xyz.File.SEEK_END)
Parameters
name (string)

the path to the file to open
mode (string or nil)

the access mode, where r is read-only and w is read-write. Nil assumes r.
Return Values
(xyz.File)

a new file object
xyz.File:seek(whence, offset) ¶

Seeks within the file.

Parameters
whence (seekconst or nil)

position to seek from, or nil to get current position
offset (number or nil)

the number of bytes relative to whence to seek
Return Values
(number)

byte position within the file
